blind.description: A stylized three-seat wooden choir stall or bench. It features three partitioned seats with dark red cushioned pads, separated by curved wooden armrests. The tall backrest has decorative recessed panels accented with gold trim and a projecting upper cornice. The lower front and rear are fully paneled in matching dark polished wood with gold moulding outlines. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and sit flat on the floor on an integrated wooden base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular structure with a wide overhanging wooden top ledge, below which three red seat cushions are visible separated by partitions, flanked by side armrests and front ledge trim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.2 feet tall (around shoulder height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 feet wide.
